packages.hook_onscreen_text: He finally told her the truth
hook_candidates: Rudeus finally sat down with the woman he broke years ago.
Mushoku Tensei just let Rudeus apologize instead of moving on.

packages.vo: Rudeus finally sat down with the woman he broke years ago. Episode 6 strands Rudeus and Sara alone on a pilgrimage escort, and he apologizes. He admits he was never in love with her, he was drowning after Eris walked away, and Sara became the person he grabbed onto to stop feeling it. Sara admits she misread it too. No yelling, just two people being honest about a relationship with no real foundation. They part on good terms. Then the episode cuts to Eris, who just earned the Sword King title, the first since Ghislaine. Was Rudeus right to call it heartbreak instead of love? Leave your take.

packages.vo: Jujutsu Kaisen's Juju Fest just got a real date. Juju Fest 2026 hits K Arena Yokohama on August 29th and 30th, closing the franchise's fifth anniversary. Cast appearances, live performances, and the update fans have wanted for months: real news on Season 4. Season 4 is confirmed as Culling Games Part 2, already in production at MAPPA, bridging to Gojo versus Sukuna, the fight fans call the series' defining moment. No release date yet, but Yokohama's been under citywide takeover since August 1st, with new anniversary art going up since the 15th. Is Gojo versus Sukuna going to live up to five years of buildup? Leave your take.
